raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 도시 산책 프로젝트를 소개해줘. 천천히 걸을 때 익숙한 거리에서 새롭게 보이는 빛과 흔적을 매력적으로 표현해줘. 서로 확연히 다른 스타일의 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 첫 두 장은 16:9 가로, 나머지 세 장은 2:3 세로로 만들어줘. 좋은 구도와 읽기 순서는 공유해도 돼. 아래 Title과 본문만 각각 한 번씩 넣고, Title은 바로 알아볼 수 있게, 본문은 휴대폰에서 편하게 이어 읽게 해줘. 새 부제, eyebrow, 날짜, 장소, footer, 로고, QR이나 다른 문구를 만들지 말아줘. 큰 고딕 글씨와 단색 바탕에 작은 이미지나 질감만 붙이는 포스터는 제외해줘.

Title: 걷다가 발견한 것들
본문: 익숙한 길을 천천히 걸으며 빛, 소리, 사람의 흔적을 만납니다. 스쳐 지나간 풍경에서 새로운 이야기를 발견해보세요.

compact_recording.execution: Inside the same fresh critic session before immutable CLI completion; no post-completion export

procedure.method: Independent fresh editorial review. Read the exact pinned packet, case, review rules, rubric, compact method and addendum, and all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing; did not follow their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts. Verified the pinned bytes and actual PNG header dimensions, separately from viewing. Used tools.view_image with detail original, forwarding each returned image through functions.exec image(), sequentially: R24-C1-M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen returned images were actually inspected in this order before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. After that complete sequence, read each Title and body in packet order from the already displayed native pixels, retaining observed line breaks, and assessed their usage and thumbnail presentations. No source opens were applicable, no view was unavailable, and no ambiguity-triggered revisit was necessary. No image creation/editing, replacement asset, peer review, maker inspection, spawn, fork or resume was used. These are semantic viewing attestations, not invented tool-event or session identifiers.

evidence.location: glass, wet pavement and pedestrians across center and right
evidence.observation: Rain marks on glass, warm lights doubled in the wet sidewalk, blurred pedestrians and a large passing-leg reflection make an ordinary urban scene worth looking at slowly. The substantial full-frame scene carries the light and human-trace content rather than serving as a tiny ornament or texture.

evidence.location: upper-left Title and lower-left body
evidence.observation: The Title is the main typographic anchor; the complete body is comfortably legible in four connected lines on the darker scene. Only the supplied Title and body appear once each; no subtitle, eyebrow, date, place, footer, logo, QR, watermark or other copy is visible. Mature thin serif-like Title forms and clean body forms remain readable.

evidence.location: whole composition relative to the other four members
evidence.observation: Dark teal photographic depth and amber reflections produce a contemplative street-observation identity distinct from M2 geometric legs, M3 stark alley silhouettes, M4 open painterly sky and M5 halftone fragments. The full scene excludes the prohibited passive gothic information template.

hierarchy.location: upper-left Title, bright right street, lower-left body

typography.location: four body lines at lower left

image_material.location: glass droplets, pavement and reflection at right

emotion_control.location: cool street shadows around warm reflected light

evidence.location: large central legs and wavy paths
evidence.observation: The leg and shoe illustration spans nearly the full width and a substantial portion of the height. It carries recognizable walking action, so it is more than a small ornament on a typographic layout.

evidence.location: three illustrated pairs of legs
evidence.observation: The sizeable legs, shoe shapes and directional ribbon-like paths provide substantive nonglyph walking content. Their presence is clear even though their urban-discovery specificity is insufficient, as recorded in style and content_form.

content_form.location: three leg pairs and floating yellow shapes
content_form.observation: The striding legs communicate walking directly, but their repetition and surrounding abstract strips do not locate the walk in a familiar city or reveal an observed light or trace. The relationship to discovering new stories rests heavily on the body copy.

hierarchy.location: top-left Title, central illustration and lower-left paragraph
hierarchy.observation: The broad illustration separates the clear headline from the four-line body without interrupting sentence order. Both copy roles remain easy to locate.
The bold Title stays identifiable and the central walking image survives reduction.

typography.observation: The bold gothic Title has coherent Hangul construction and clear word spaces; the lighter body is consistent and intact.
The four evenly separated lines preserve punctuation and make a natural two-sentence paragraph without crowded endings.

space.location: left copy margin and full-width wave band
space.observation: Title and paragraph share a stable left margin. The central wave band uses the landscape width, and the right oval counterbalances the large left text block; the remaining peach area reads as deliberate graphic breathing room.

image_material.location: orange folds, navy shoes and blue ribbons
image_material.observation: Angular folds and shoes are constructed consistently within a flat cut-shape vocabulary. Their edges are clean and the limited colors hold together; the issue is generic content rather than a broken material treatment.

emotion_control.location: repeated leg rhythm and bright pastel field
emotion_control.observation: The cheerful regular rhythm feels like a general walking campaign. The identical pairs and unexplained floating elements give little sense of an attentive pause or the surprise of noticing an everyday urban detail. Expressive brightness itself is not the problem.

ai_slop.location: middle yellow quadrilateral and oval loops at right
ai_slop.observation: The repeated walking motif and detached yellow patches and blue loops read as generic decorative additions without a visible content-specific relationship. There is no extra pseudo-copy, but the graphic still needs those relationships resolved.

residuals: The graphic is readable and substantial, but the visual premise remains generic walking rather than attentive urban discovery.
The yellow quadrilaterals and oval loops have no visibly established relationship to a street detail, light source, sound event or human trace. No invisible symbolism was credited.
Repeated legs provide rhythm without showing changes of attention or different discovered details; content_form, emotion_control and ai_slop remain below the professional-resolution floor.

image_material.location: silhouette facades, cables, railing and ground marks

evidence.location: street fragments around the center-left cream opening
evidence.observation: The shoe/leg, worn metal curve, striped ground and shadow forms dominate the upper, right and lower areas. Their recognizable walking and street-surface content extends beyond the dot texture and lettering.

evidence.location: stepping form and rust-colored wear at right
evidence.observation: The poster connects a physical step to close attention to worn urban material and patterned light/shadow, giving the abstracted print surface specific walking and trace content.

content_form.location: upper step, right rail detail and lower stripes
content_form.observation: The montage chooses a step and everyday worn street details rather than a general skyline. Cropping and enlarged surface detail suit the act of finding stories in things passed on foot.

hierarchy.location: cream opening containing Title and body
hierarchy.observation: The large navy Title leads directly into the four-line paragraph, while the darker image fragments wrap around the cream area. The right metal curve supplies a secondary focal detail without obscuring the copy.
The Title remains a strong readable anchor and the step/rail/striped image structure stays visible at small size.

typography.location: heavy gothic Title and medium-weight body
typography.observation: The Hangul counters and strokes remain clean against the distressed imagery. Word spaces distinguish the three Title words, and the body retains punctuation without carrying the halftone noise into the glyphs.
The body is large enough to read comfortably, with a consistent left edge, line spacing and an immediate connection to the Title.

space.location: irregular cream text opening against cropped edges
space.observation: A purposeful cream opening contains both copy roles while the image cuts extend beyond the edges. Diagonal striped space below and the large curve at right balance the dense upper fragment.

image_material.location: halftone transitions and rust on the curved rail
image_material.observation: The navy dot fields, broken printed edges and small orange wear marks hold together as a coherent print-like collage treatment. The content objects remain identifiable beneath the material effect.

emotion_control.location: contrasting step silhouette, stripes and worn metal detail
emotion_control.observation: High contrast and close cropping create an alert, tactile curiosity about everyday movement and used surfaces. The controlled orange accent keeps the density from becoming indiscriminate visual noise.

ai_slop.location: image fragments around the cream opening
ai_slop.observation: The fragments share the same ink vocabulary and belong to street movement and surfaces; no floating unrelated icon or pseudo-lettering appears. Their different scales read as a montage rather than a failed continuous perspective, though their connection remains associative.

residuals: The upper step and right metal detail operate at different scales; their relation is associative collage rather than one continuous street scene.
The dense striped halftone vocabulary is familiar. It remains content-bearing through the step and wear detail, but does not reach exceptional refinement in every local junction.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: whole composition compared with M4
evidence.observation: Layered rainy photographic depth, cool darkness, amber reflected light and a slender one-line Title produce a contemplative identity. evidence.location: central walking band compared with M1 and M5
evidence.observation: Three repeated angular leg pairs on blue waves and peach ground form a crisp cheerful geometric graphic. It differs from M1 atmospheric scene depth and M5 cropped halftone street fragments, although its specific urban message remains weak.

evidence.location: diagonal alley and Title compared with M4 and M5
evidence.observation: The hard black alley mass, receding ground marks, cream sky and tiny orange window build a continuous, quiet graphic street. The two-line serif-like Title overlaps M4 in typographic structure, but M4 painterly open sky and M5 enlarged print fragments have different image and emotional identities.

evidence.location: architectural frame and sky compared with M3
evidence.observation: Broad brushwork, warm/cool painted walls and an upward sky opening convey bright domestic curiosity. M3 shares an alley subject and two-line Title but uses enclosed black silhouettes, a walked trail and a single warm point; their achieved identities remain clearly distinct.

evidence.location: cropped step, rail and striped field compared with M2 and M3
evidence.observation: Bold central gothic type is integrated with close-up halftone movement, stripes, wear and rust-orange detail. M2 also uses gothic type but has smooth cut-shape repetition and spacious horizontal waves; M3 has print-like contrast but a coherent distant alley rather than a tactile fragment montage.

residuals: Five distinct achieved identities are present, but diversity alone does not resolve M2 content specificity and its three below-floor ratings.

Shared four-line body wrapping is visible across the set, and M3/M4 share a two-line serif-like Title. These permitted reading-structure overlaps were assessed within each whole identity, not treated as a requirement for five different layouts.

This is one independent editorial review only. No other critic records were inspected, so no all-three-critic image or set PASS is asserted. The packet contains no source assets or protected layouts; source fidelity arrays are explicitly empty.

{"mode": "open", "invocation_interpretation": "Skill invocation is not a tape material requirement"}

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Each of the supplied Title and body entries appears once with exact Korean/word boundaries/punctuation. No invented or additional copy roles, event data, logo, QR or watermark.
Five independent flat opaque single posters with each role's requested ratio; no comparison sheet or mockup.
Five clearly distinct achieved styles: image expression/editing, color/contrast, typographic voice, material/finish and emotion form intentional identities. Shared good layouts/order/alignment allowed; five unique component values/media/layouts not required. Filter/palette/font substitutions alone insufficient.

Title immediately recognizable as the main typographic anchor; the full body is comfortably readable and naturally connected at usage720, with harmonious mature Korean forms. No missing role is required.
Exclude passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/information templates with subordinate imagery, tiny-image/texture/font substitution or empty-room dressing. Gothic, whitespace and coherent image-led scenes allowed.

evidence.location: central illustration from left edge to right edge
evidence.observation: Large walking legs/shoes and route ribbons fill a substantial horizontal band, with loops and yellow shapes of comparable visual scale. The nonglyph action is integral rather than a subordinate tiny ornament.

evidence.location: three walking pairs and two blue ribbons
evidence.observation: Repeated changing foot positions communicate a walking sequence over a path; the route and bright interruptions provide a nonglyph movement/trace/light vocabulary. This meets substantive content, while the particular urban discovery is less specific than in the other members.

content_form.location: central legs, ribbons and yellow quadrilaterals
content_form.observation: The feet and horizontal paths clearly signify walking, but no differentiated street object, surface or lived urban trace is developed. The two floating yellow shapes and large ring route remain general graphic signs, so the particular experience of noticing familiar urban light is only loosely communicated.

hierarchy.location: Title above illustration and body below
hierarchy.observation: The single bold Title leads into a wide walking band and then a readable lower-left body. The loop stays in the image region and does not introduce another text anchor.
The four lines are uninterrupted and ordered naturally, with sufficient distance from the shoes above.

typography.observation: Blue gothic Hangul is intact, weight is consistent and word gaps are recognizable; the body uses a lighter weight than the large Title.

Both commas and periods remain clear and the four-line block reads comfortably against the peach ground. The conventional type treatment is clean, although it is not a distinctive typographic achievement by itself.

space.location: left text inset and central image band
space.observation: Title/body align consistently, the horizontal graphic has room between the copy blocks and the generous right-hand area accommodates the large loop. The image crosses the boundaries intentionally without cutting either text role.

image_material.location: three folded trouser pairs and right-hand loop/shoe junction
image_material.observation: The cut-paper-like planes are legible, but the three very similar trouser/foot constructions stay at a stock-symbol level. The rightmost shoe/loop/ribbon intersection creates a crowded overlap without a comparably precise material or spatial payoff; the yellow flat shapes are less integrated than the gait forms.

emotion_control.location: repeated gait and bold blue/red/peach arrangement
emotion_control.observation: The graphic rhythm feels upbeat and accessible. Its nearly equivalent repeated steps and decorative loops yield a broad walking-campaign mood rather than a specific sense of slowing down to notice an overlooked urban detail.

ai_slop.location: yellow quadrilaterals and concentric loop at right
ai_slop.observation: Two floating yellow quadrilaterals and the oversized double loop look like general-purpose graphic additions, without a visible found-object or street-surface relationship. The repeated leg symbols reinforce the same simple gesture rather than providing observed detail, leaving the image vocabulary generic. There is no visible extra copy or severe glyph corruption.

residuals: The visual signifies walking successfully, but city-specific light and human traces are weakly developed; this is the content_form 3 finding.

Repeated trouser/foot symbols, floating yellow quadrilaterals and the large double loop remain less integrated and specific than a resolved content-led illustration, supporting image_material 3, emotion_control 3 and ai_slop 3.
The clean type and substantial full-width illustration do not remove those low craft findings.

evidence.observation: The houses, cables, railings and advancing step marks remain a dominant recognizable scene even at thumbnail scale; the typography does not carry the entire concept alone.

evidence.location: orange domestic window and pale step marks in black street
evidence.observation: A small warm window becomes the discovery inside a larger lived neighborhood, while the step trail visibly directs a walk through it. The imagery communicates the requested light and traces with concrete nonglyph relationships.

content_form.location: central alley, plant-filled windows and stepping trail
content_form.observation: Everyday domestic details, an isolated warm window and a receding trail of paired marks make the theme legible without additional explanatory copy. The urban setting and human passage are specific and connected.

hierarchy.location: upper Title, orange window, trail and lower body
hierarchy.observation: The large two-line Title anchors the open upper-left; the orange window supplies a secondary scene focal point, and the trail leads toward the lower body area. Neither the window nor the building mass obscures the reading order.
The four body lines form one clearly subordinate block with intact sentence continuity.

typography.observation: Heavy serif Title and lighter serif body share a compatible stroke language; Korean syllables and word boundaries remain intact. The slight ink-like edge character fits the silhouette image.
Generous glyph size and line spacing allow an easy full reading. The Title/body weight difference is substantial without introducing mismatched type voices.

space.location: diagonal boundary from lower-left railing to lower-right step trail
space.observation: The black street wedge simultaneously creates a broad sky pocket for the Title and a cream lower-left pocket for the body; the trail transitions between the pockets without entering the text. These spaces arise from the scene rather than unrelated rectangles.

space.location: whole diagonal composition
space.observation: The largest building mass balances the large Title at left; the narrowing trace directs depth and the lower text wedge retains a clear margin. The proportion and reading path remain strongly resolved at reduced scale.

image_material.location: wires, railings, plants and windows along right-hand architecture
image_material.observation: Thin pale structural lines remain coherent within broad black shapes. Small plants and the orange window add local specificity while the rough silhouette edges preserve a convincing graphic-print finish. The paired step marks are simplified shapes rather than detailed tread prints.

emotion_control.location: orange window inside the dark neighborhood
emotion_control.observation: A single warm domestic light against the still black street produces a controlled sense of quiet discovery. The directional stepping trail invites looking along the neighborhood instead of making the scene merely ominous.

ai_slop.location: architectural linework, lit window and footpath
ai_slop.observation: Wires, balconies, plants and windows belong to the same neighborhood scene; their silhouettes have a consistent visual grammar. The limited accent and visible step trail are related to the content, with no unrelated icons, spurious text or conspicuous generated fragments.

residuals: The footprint trail uses simplified irregular paired ovals, with limited shoe-specific detail; its direction and role remain readable.
The heavy building silhouettes intentionally suppress façade detail; the review judges the visible graphic neighborhood, not an inferred exact real street.

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Each of the supplied Title and body entries appears once with exact Korean/word boundaries/punctuation. No invented or additional copy roles, event data, logo, QR or watermark.

evidence.location: upper walking fragments, right shoe and lower pavement stripes
evidence.observation: The nonglyph scene remains extensive and legible around the text opening, with major forms above, right and below. It is not a small ornament or texture-only supplement to the headline.

evidence.location: foreground shoe wear and patterned street around the central text opening
evidence.observation: The close shoe and scuffed orange/dark marks focus attention on human wear and street surfaces while the upper limbs signal walking. Those visible details ground the project’s traces/light theme in a graphic street encounter.

content_form.location: large shoe at right and upper-left walking foot
content_form.observation: The near shoe wear and larger walking fragments give human passage a tangible subject; striped pavement and light/dark marks shift attention to the surfaces normally passed over. The collage relates to walking rather than substituting unrelated decorative imagery.

hierarchy.location: center-left Title/body opening framed by shoe and legs
hierarchy.observation: The large Title is immediately readable, with the complete body directly below as a single subordinate unit. The large image fragments are forceful but leave a coherent clear opening for both text roles.
Body reading proceeds down a stable left edge, with no image texture intruding on the glyphs.

typography.location: bold navy Title and smaller navy body
typography.observation: Clean gothic Hangul contrasts with the coarse image grain. Word boundaries and punctuation are intact, and the body’s reduced size/weight establishes a clear role difference.

typography.location: second Title line and body line endings
typography.observation: The space in 발견한 것들 and the four body lines remain easy to parse; consistent blue color and left alignment hold the roles together.

space.location: irregular cream opening from center-left to lower-middle
space.observation: The opening closely contains the two text roles while allowing breathing space below the body. The oversized shoe stops to the right of the lines, and the lower street stripes continue the scene to the bottom.

space.location: upper cropped foot and lower striped area
space.observation: Large directional fragments balance the central-left text weight across the full height without requiring extra labels or filler.

image_material.location: foreground shoe, halftone leg edges and cream/navy pavement stripes
image_material.observation: Coarse dots and distressed edges create a consistent print/collage finish, while eyelet-like details, the curved shoe edge and sparse orange wear remain legible. Differing crops/scales are overt collage editing, not a claim of one seamless photographic perspective.

emotion_control.location: diagonal limbs and cropped worn shoe beside clear type
emotion_control.observation: High contrast and close cropping create an active, tactile urban curiosity. The attention to worn footwear and surface patterns keeps the energy connected to looking at traces, rather than undirected visual noise.

ai_slop.location: grain distribution, shoe detail and text opening
ai_slop.observation: Halftone/coarse wear follows the shoe, leg and pavement forms; the cream copy opening keeps grain away from the text. Sparse orange marks belong to visible wear/detail rather than unrelated stickers. No extra copy, logo or obvious glyph anomaly is visible.

residuals: The graphic collage is more forceful and active than the quiet observations in M1/M3/M4; its relationship to slow discovery relies on the enlarged surface and footwear details.
Coarse halftone and differing fragment scales limit fine shoe/anatomical inspection; the visible construction is judged as an overt collage rather than a continuous photographic scene.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: whole frame
evidence.observation: Full-bleed wet-glass photography, amber/teal depth and a thin serif Title produce an intimate rainy street identity. Unlike M3/M4 it retains optical blur/reflection, and unlike M2/M5 the type is restrained within photographic light.

evidence.location: horizontal gait band and blue sans text
evidence.observation: Smooth planar legs, two wave paths and large loops make a playful schematic walking identity. Its navy/gothic elements are shared with M5, but image scale, smooth planes, horizontal repetition and light peach ground work together differently from M5’s coarse diagonal collage.

evidence.location: black alley, orange window and receding step trail
evidence.observation: Hard silhouettes, a single warm window and paired street marks create a quiet domestic print identity. Although M4 also has serif type and houses, the dark street-level trace, severe black/cream contrast and diagonal mass are distinctly different from M4’s airy upward painted view.

evidence.location: sky opening and full-height painted houses
evidence.observation: Broad strokes, blue daylight, an upward frame of weathered houses and a fine serif body establish an open, leisurely painterly identity. Its sky and wall light remain different from M1’s evening glass reflection and M3’s flat dark alley, beyond palette alone.

evidence.location: large shoe, diagonally cropped legs and pavement stripes
evidence.observation: Coarse halftone fragments, enlarged footwear, orange wear, assertive sans type and compressed cream text opening form a tactile graphic street identity. It differs from M2’s smooth generic symbol rhythm and M3’s coherent silhouette depth even though it shares some ink colors and a print-like finish.

residuals: The five whole identities are clearly distinct at the specified views, but M2’s general-purpose symbols give it less content-specific refinement than the other four; diversity 4 does not cancel its individual scores of 3.

Serif treatments recur in M1/M3/M4 and bold gothic treatments recur in M2/M5. Shared type categories and good reading arrangements are allowed; the achieved differences here depend on image editing, contrast, finish and emotional relationships as well.

This is one independent craft review of the pinned selected five-member packet. It does not establish the other two critics’ judgments, actual runtime session identity, maker intent, unseen earlier stages or quality on other requests. No supplied source assets or protected layouts are available/applicable.

typography.location: Title and body in dark blue serif
typography.observation: Consistent serif Hangul connects the large Title with the finer body. The glyphs, word spaces and punctuation are intact, and the type color relates to the cool roof shadows.

typography.location: four body lines against lightly textured sky
typography.observation: The smaller body is still readable with open leading and sufficient local contrast; cloud brushwork does not interrupt the line endings. Thumbnail body detail is small, while the Title remains recognizable.

space.location: upper sky Title pocket and lower central body pocket

space.location: scene between the two copy roles

image_material.location: left roof planes, right wall, clouds and hanging cloth

emotion_control.location: blue sky framed by warm left wall and cool right buildings
emotion_control.observation: Open daylight and loose brush rhythm create a controlled, generous invitation to look up and walk slowly. Ordinary cables and worn façades keep the calm tied to the city rather than generic scenic prettiness.

ai_slop.location: roof outlines, cables and lower building cluster
ai_slop.observation: Roof and wall planes remain recognizable, cable lines connect across the scene and painted irregularities follow the brush language. No spurious signage, extra lettering or unrelated decorative icons are visible; distant building details are simplified within the painting.

residuals: The body is smaller and more interior than M3/M5; it is comfortable at the prescribed usage720 view, while the thumbnail body has limited detailed legibility.

content_form.observation: The near shoe wear and larger walking fragments give human passage a tangible subject; striped pavement and light/dark marks shift attention to the surfaces normally passed over. The collage relates to walking rather than substituting unrelated decorative imagery.

Body reading proceeds down a stable left edge, with no image texture intruding on the glyphs.

typography.location: bold navy Title and smaller navy body
typography.observation: Clean gothic Hangul contrasts with the coarse image grain. Word boundaries and punctuation are intact, and the body’s reduced size/weight establishes a clear role difference.

typography.location: second Title line and body line endings
typography.observation: The space in 발견한 것들 and the four body lines remain easy to parse; consistent blue color and left alignment hold the roles together.

space.location: irregular cream opening from center-left to lower-middle
space.observation: The opening closely contains the two text roles while allowing breathing space below the body. The oversized shoe stops to the right of the lines, and the lower street stripes continue the scene to the bottom.

space.location: upper cropped foot and lower striped area
space.observation: Large directional fragments balance the central-left text weight across the full height without requiring extra labels or filler.

image_material.location: foreground shoe, halftone leg edges and cream/navy pavement stripes
image_material.observation: Coarse dots and distressed edges create a consistent print/collage finish, while eyelet-like details, the curved shoe edge and sparse orange wear remain legible. Differing crops/scales are overt collage editing, not a claim of one seamless photographic perspective.

emotion_control.location: diagonal limbs and cropped worn shoe beside clear type
emotion_control.observation: High contrast and close cropping create an active, tactile urban curiosity. The attention to worn footwear and surface patterns keeps the energy connected to looking at traces, rather than undirected visual noise.

ai_slop.location: grain distribution, shoe detail and text opening
ai_slop.observation: Halftone/coarse wear follows the shoe, leg and pavement forms; the cream copy opening keeps grain away from the text. Sparse orange marks belong to visible wear/detail rather than unrelated stickers. No extra copy, logo or obvious glyph anomaly is visible.

residuals: The graphic collage is more forceful and active than the quiet observations in M1/M3/M4; its relationship to slow discovery relies on the enlarged surface and footwear details.
Coarse halftone and differing fragment scales limit fine shoe/anatomical inspection; the visible construction is judged as an overt collage rather than a continuous photographic scene.

evidence.location: whole frame
evidence.observation: Full-bleed wet-glass photography, amber/teal depth and a thin serif Title produce an intimate rainy street identity. Unlike M3/M4 it retains optical blur/reflection, and unlike M2/M5 the type is restrained within photographic light.

evidence.location: horizontal gait band and blue sans text
evidence.observation: Smooth planar legs, two wave paths and large loops make a playful schematic walking identity. Its navy/gothic elements are shared with M5, but image scale, smooth planes, horizontal repetition and light peach ground work together differently from M5’s coarse diagonal collage.

evidence.location: black alley, orange window and receding step trail
evidence.observation: Hard silhouettes, a single warm window and paired street marks create a quiet domestic print identity. Although M4 also has serif type and houses, the dark street-level trace, severe black/cream contrast and diagonal mass are distinctly different from M4’s airy upward painted view.

evidence.location: sky opening and full-height painted houses
evidence.observation: Broad strokes, blue daylight, an upward frame of weathered houses and a fine serif body establish an open, leisurely painterly identity. Its sky and wall light remain different from M1’s evening glass reflection and M3’s flat dark alley, beyond palette alone.

evidence.location: large shoe, diagonally cropped legs and pavement stripes
evidence.observation: Coarse halftone fragments, enlarged footwear, orange wear, assertive sans type and compressed cream text opening form a tactile graphic street identity. It differs from M2’s smooth generic symbol rhythm and M3’s coherent silhouette depth even though it shares some ink colors and a print-like finish.

residuals: The five whole identities are clearly distinct at the specified views, but M2’s general-purpose symbols give it less content-specific refinement than the other four; diversity 4 does not cancel its individual scores of 3.

Serif treatments recur in M1/M3/M4 and bold gothic treatments recur in M2/M5. Shared type categories and good reading arrangements are allowed; the achieved differences here depend on image editing, contrast, finish and emotional relationships as well.

This is one independent craft review of the pinned selected five-member packet. It does not establish the other two critics’ judgments, actual runtime session identity, maker intent, unseen earlier stages or quality on other requests. No supplied source assets or protected layouts are available/applicable.

procedure.method: Independent fresh critic session; no spawning, forking, resuming, peer review, producer explanation or unlisted embedded path was used. Read the literal packet/case, pinned rubric/rules and compact method/addendum. The packet declares zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so there were no source opens or protected-layout reads to perform. Read all five exact pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing, without following their embedded source/input/final paths. Verified the pins, byte counts and PNG-header dimensions of all fifteen declared poster assets. Actually opened and visually inspected each through tools.view_image with detail original, forwarding its returned image_url with image at original detail: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in that same three-view order. All fifteen returned images were displayed and inspected before the first poster copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. After the fifteenth display, read the poster text from those already displayed exact views in member/copy order; did not reopen an image or use OCR, required-text substitution or a transcription revisit. Judged only visible pixels. The two 1672x941 landscapes pass 16:9 by the declared single-edge rounding: 941 differs from 1672*9/16=940.5 by 0.5 pixel; they are not mathematically exact 16:9. The three 1024x1536 portraits are mathematically exact 2:3. Usage views are 720x405 or 720x1080; thumbnails are 320x180 or 213x320, with aspect preserved to integer sampling and no upsampling. Actual session identity is unavailable here and remains null.

The visible relationship among the fragments is insufficiently refined, retained in the content/material ratings rather than replaced with an unseen object narrative.

content_form.location: upper shoe-like forms and center-right curved detail
content_form.observation: The montage suggests walking and close observation of worn urban surfaces, but the shoe/ground relationships and curved object's identity are not cleanly legible. The specific encountered story remains weak.

content_form.location: three differently directed stripe fields
content_form.observation: The strong graphic pattern competes with recognition of street details, so the image functions more readily as an energetic walking collage than a resolved discovery of light and human traces.

hierarchy.observation: The title's mass clearly anchors the composition; the paragraph follows directly in the same high-contrast ivory area and remains complete.
The headline stays immediately readable despite busy perimeter texture; dark diagonal fragments direct attention into the central copy island.

typography.location: heavy gothic title and four-line body
typography.observation: The dark Korean letterforms are consistent and robust; full words, spaces, commas and periods remain distinct. Title/body weight relationships are deliberate rather than damaged glyphs.
The body has sufficient size and line separation against the clean ivory area, with no intrusion by the surrounding halftone.

space.location: irregular ivory island and outer crops
space.observation: An asymmetrical light opening reserves room for the large title and paragraph while diagonal and vertical crops keep the perimeter active. The text is inset from the rough image boundary.

space.location: whole portrait
space.observation: The compact central reading area remains a stable focal mass, balanced by the tall dark right side and striped lower section.

image_material.location: upper-center dark form and diagonal striped surface
image_material.observation: The coarse halftone finish is consistent, but overlapping cropped shapes lose a convincing boundary between walking form, shadow and ground. Object construction is only partly legible even at native.

image_material.location: orange-speckled oval at right meeting vertical stripes
image_material.observation: The large curved detail crosses differently oriented cropped surfaces without a clear spatial connection. The local joins reduce the collage's specificity and finish.

emotion_control.location: navy/ivory contrasts and small orange accents
emotion_control.observation: Strong directional crops and dry grain produce a tactile, alert street mood; the restrained orange wear accents focus the force instead of scattering many colors. An energetic open-style treatment can serve attentive noticing.

emotion_control.location: whole graphic
emotion_control.observation: The rough, forceful emotional identity survives at small scale and remains clearly different from the reflective calm of M1 and airy daylight of M4.

ai_slop.location: upper dark shoe-like silhouette and center-right ring/stripe overlaps
ai_slop.observation: Several image fragments remain visually disconnected: the upper silhouette lacks a cleanly resolved leg/ground boundary, and the orange-edged oval overlays separate stripe systems without an intelligible join. These unresolved local relationships leave an assembled-stock-fragment quality.

ai_slop.location: upper-left light spots and multiple directional stripe fields
ai_slop.observation: Bright spot fragments and repeated stripe textures add graphic bustle but are not clearly tied to a particular encountered street detail, reinforcing generic montage rather than specific selection.

residuals: The exact function of the orange-speckled curved object cannot be identified confidently from the pixels; it is recorded as a curved worn detail, without inventing a puddle, handrail, wheel or maker story.

The upper dark fragments suggest shoes/walking but their precise leg/shadow/ground boundaries remain weak. This visible lack of scene legibility drives content_form3, image_material3 and ai_slop3; all assets and copy remain assessable.
Bold typography and a coherent halftone palette do not cancel the low image/content judgments. The graphic emotional force was assessed within the open brief, without requiring a muted mood.
The navy/cream bold-gothic family resembles M2, while editing, local finish and framing are substantially different.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: whole landscape and reflective right half
evidence.observation: Full-bleed wet-street photography, amber against blue-black, thin light serif title and small light sans body produce a quiet cinematic identity. Continuous glass/reflection depth distinguishes it from the other four constructed graphic or painted images, including the blue daylight of M4.

evidence.location: central horizontal walking strip
evidence.observation: Three angular orange trouser-and-shoe units, smooth undulating blue bands, floating yellow quadrilaterals and large blue loops make a bright schematic graphic. Its bold gothic voice and navy/cream family overlap M5, but its clean planar repeated figures and horizontal rhythm differ substantially from M5's coarse cropped montage.

evidence.location: diagonal alley, upper-left title and orange window
evidence.observation: Black silhouette architecture cuts a continuous rising alley into ivory; a receding paired trail and one orange domestic window are joined by dense heavy serif lettering. It shares a two-line title and alley subject with M4, but flat cut edges, near-binary contrast and nocturnal enclosure give it a separate whole identity.

evidence.location: open central sky between buildings
evidence.observation: Blue sky, warm plaster, cool roof shadows, visible painterly strokes and softer dark serif copy make an airy upward-looking scene. Its continuous daylight atmosphere and expansive sky differ from M3's compressed black alley and from M1's wet nocturnal glass.

evidence.location: diagonal crops around the central ivory text island
evidence.observation: Coarse navy halftone, orange-speckled curved detail, cropped dark shoe-like silhouettes and several directional stripe fields surround a very heavy gothic title. The rough close-up fragments and irregular text island differ from M2's smooth complete vector units and M3's coherent long-view silhouette scene.

evidence.location: relationships across all five finished members
evidence.observation: The set varies image framing/editing, contrast structure, finish, type voice and emotional effect together. M1 is reflective and cinematic, M2 schematic and buoyant, M3 enclosed and graphic, M4 airy and painterly, and M5 forceful and tactile. These are observed composite differences rather than five material names or palette/filter changes. All five are independent opaque single-poster compositions.

residuals: Diversity is resolved at 4, not exceptional: the navy/cream heavy-gothic pairing of M2/M5 and the serif two-line alley pairing of M3/M4 remain family resemblances. Shared reading order is allowed and was not treated as a mandatory defect.

Count and diversity do not erase M2's literal content shortfall or the low dimension records for M2 and M5. This record supplies one independent critic; it does not establish the other two critics' judgments or a combined all-three gate.

provenance.viewing_limit: freshness/completion are trace-backed; semantic viewing/order remain critic attestations

content_form.location: whole image

typography.observation: The slender serif Hangul title has deliberate open spacing; the plainer body retains clear syllable blocks, word spaces, commas and periods.

space.location: left text edges and glass diagonal

space.location: gap between title and paragraph

image_material.location: droplets, panel mullions and bottom-right tiles

image_material.location: right half
image_material.observation: The depth and reflective surface relationships survive downsampling; bright bokeh remains controlled enough to preserve the street.

emotion_control.location: blue-black left and amber right

emotion_control.location: whole scene

ai_slop.location: window framing, wet floor and traffic silhouettes

ai_slop.location: whole composition

space.location: irregular ivory island and outer crops
space.observation: An asymmetrical light opening reserves room for the large title and paragraph while diagonal and vertical crops keep the perimeter active. The text is inset from the rough image boundary.

space.location: whole portrait
space.observation: The compact central reading area remains a stable focal mass, balanced by the tall dark right side and striped lower section.

image_material.location: upper-center dark form and diagonal striped surface
image_material.observation: The coarse halftone finish is consistent, but overlapping cropped shapes lose a convincing boundary between walking form, shadow and ground. Object construction is only partly legible even at native.

image_material.location: orange-speckled oval at right meeting vertical stripes
image_material.observation: The large curved detail crosses differently oriented cropped surfaces without a clear spatial connection. The local joins reduce the collage's specificity and finish.

emotion_control.location: navy/ivory contrasts and small orange accents
emotion_control.observation: Strong directional crops and dry grain produce a tactile, alert street mood; the restrained orange wear accents focus the force instead of scattering many colors. An energetic open-style treatment can serve attentive noticing.

emotion_control.location: whole graphic
emotion_control.observation: The rough, forceful emotional identity survives at small scale and remains clearly different from the reflective calm of M1 and airy daylight of M4.

ai_slop.location: upper dark shoe-like silhouette and center-right ring/stripe overlaps
ai_slop.observation: Several image fragments remain visually disconnected: the upper silhouette lacks a cleanly resolved leg/ground boundary, and the orange-edged oval overlays separate stripe systems without an intelligible join. These unresolved local relationships leave an assembled-stock-fragment quality.

ai_slop.location: upper-left light spots and multiple directional stripe fields
ai_slop.observation: Bright spot fragments and repeated stripe textures add graphic bustle but are not clearly tied to a particular encountered street detail, reinforcing generic montage rather than specific selection.

residuals: The exact function of the orange-speckled curved object cannot be identified confidently from the pixels; it is recorded as a curved worn detail, without inventing a puddle, handrail, wheel or maker story.

The upper dark fragments suggest shoes/walking but their precise leg/shadow/ground boundaries remain weak. This visible lack of scene legibility drives content_form3, image_material3 and ai_slop3; all assets and copy remain assessable.
Bold typography and a coherent halftone palette do not cancel the low image/content judgments. The graphic emotional force was assessed within the open brief, without requiring a muted mood.
The navy/cream bold-gothic family resembles M2, while editing, local finish and framing are substantially different.

evidence.location: whole landscape and reflective right half
evidence.observation: Full-bleed wet-street photography, amber against blue-black, thin light serif title and small light sans body produce a quiet cinematic identity. Continuous glass/reflection depth distinguishes it from the other four constructed graphic or painted images, including the blue daylight of M4.

evidence.location: central horizontal walking strip
evidence.observation: Three angular orange trouser-and-shoe units, smooth undulating blue bands, floating yellow quadrilaterals and large blue loops make a bright schematic graphic. Its bold gothic voice and navy/cream family overlap M5, but its clean planar repeated figures and horizontal rhythm differ substantially from M5's coarse cropped montage.

evidence.location: diagonal alley, upper-left title and orange window
evidence.observation: Black silhouette architecture cuts a continuous rising alley into ivory; a receding paired trail and one orange domestic window are joined by dense heavy serif lettering. It shares a two-line title and alley subject with M4, but flat cut edges, near-binary contrast and nocturnal enclosure give it a separate whole identity.

evidence.location: open central sky between buildings
evidence.observation: Blue sky, warm plaster, cool roof shadows, visible painterly strokes and softer dark serif copy make an airy upward-looking scene. Its continuous daylight atmosphere and expansive sky differ from M3's compressed black alley and from M1's wet nocturnal glass.

evidence.location: diagonal crops around the central ivory text island
evidence.observation: Coarse navy halftone, orange-speckled curved detail, cropped dark shoe-like silhouettes and several directional stripe fields surround a very heavy gothic title. The rough close-up fragments and irregular text island differ from M2's smooth complete vector units and M3's coherent long-view silhouette scene.

evidence.location: relationships across all five finished members
evidence.observation: The set varies image framing/editing, contrast structure, finish, type voice and emotional effect together. M1 is reflective and cinematic, M2 schematic and buoyant, M3 enclosed and graphic, M4 airy and painterly, and M5 forceful and tactile. These are observed composite differences rather than five material names or palette/filter changes. All five are independent opaque single-poster compositions.

residuals: Diversity is resolved at 4, not exceptional: the navy/cream heavy-gothic pairing of M2/M5 and the serif two-line alley pairing of M3/M4 remain family resemblances. Shared reading order is allowed and was not treated as a mandatory defect.

Count and diversity do not erase M2's literal content shortfall or the low dimension records for M2 and M5. This record supplies one independent critic; it does not establish the other two critics' judgments or a combined all-three gate.
